description: Generate AGAIN an existing AI package resource of a video in one language — PAID and cannot be undone: the current one is deleted first, including every edit made to it. Cost: 1 credit per minute of video (minimum 1 min; a partial minute counts only past 1 s); free on an active Gold/Enterprise plan while the daily AI quota lasts (checked before sending). Without new settings it reuses the previous ones. Refused while the resource is still generating, for uploaded PDF eBooks, or when the balance doesn't cover it. Also the way to make a legacy (old package) resource editable. Returns {video_id, resource, lang, gross_cost_credits, cost_credits, free_by_daily_quota, response}; response is the queued request, and while it generates the resource is missing from the video.
